contexts.text: Every man is in some Society of infernals... but their torments are not communicated to him, because he is in preparation for eternal life.
The reason they were not admitted, was that they were not yet prepared to be in angelic Societies.
The man in good is in Society with Angels... but cannot perceive angelic joy, because he is in... preparation.
These three verses treat of the preparation... of the natural man. Explained.
See Prepare. AR 700. TCR 24.
Further preparation. Signified.
a. Holy preparation and disposition. Signified.
The preparation of all (for judgment). Signified.
A state of preparation through temptations. Signified.
A state of initiation of the interiors, that is, of preparation to receive the influx of good and truth. Signified. AC 7849, Explained. AC 7878:end.
Preparation for enjoyment by all... who are of the Spiritual Church. Signified.
Preparation for the Lord's presence. Signified.

Because they were not yet prepared. Signified. They could not be introduced into Heaven until they had undergone temptations, and the Lord had thereby confirmed truths and goods, and had conjoined them. This is here meant by being prepared.
What is successive continually until they were prepared. Signified.
Let them prepare what they have brought () = the disposition of appropriated goods.
Preparation for the conjunction of good; (and) preparation for the conjunction of truth. Signified, Explained.
Preparation to receive truth Divine from the Lord. Treated of. AC 8786. AC 8790.

The place which I have prepared () = Heaven... To prepare, when said concerning Heaven, = to give it from mercy to those in the good of life and of faith; for Heaven is said to be prepared for these. Illustrated... For to prepare Heaven is to prepare those who are to be introduced into Heaven; for Heaven is given according to the preparation; that is, according to the reception of good...
A guard lest that Heaven be entered except by those prepared. Signified, Explained.

No one is introduced into Heaven unless he is prepared. Explained... Their preparation is effected by the separation of the worldly and terrestrial things they have brought with them... When they have been prepared, they are elevated and introduced by the Lord into Heaven...
The worship of the Lord from the truths and goods of faith and love, and thus preparation for reception. Signified, Explained.
In the World of Spirits... all are explored, and are prepared. Explained.
The gates and doors to the heavenly Societies appear solely to those who are prepared for Heaven. Described.
The third state of man after death, is that of his preparation. HH 512, Explained.
Those who are at once taken up into Heaven, are those who have been regenerated, and thus prepared for Heaven, in the world. Described.
Those instructed in the world have been also prepared for Heaven there by the Lord, and are conveyed into Heaven by another way. Explained.
As the Lord foresees this, He continually provides that man may be such; for thus everyone who suffers himself to be led to Heaven, is prepared for his own place there. DP 68, Explained.
But the man who does not suffer himself to be led to Heaven, is prepared for his own place in Hell. Explained.
All who have been prepared for Heaven, which is done in the World of Spirits, ... long for Heaven; and presently their eyes are opened, and they see a way...
This happens to all after death; for thus the evil are prepared for Hell, and the good for Heaven, Signified, Explained.

They know that in the World of Spirits... all are first prepared, the good for Heaven, and the evil for Hell; and that when they have been prepared, they see ways open to them to Societies of their like...
Ten Spirits prepared to stay in Heaven for three days.
a. 2. The preparation (in the World of Spirits) has for its end that the Internal and the External may make a one.
When this is done, he is prepared for Heaven.
I saw them brought back, because they were not yet prepared (for Hell).
That there is continual preparation for life by the Lord, and never life. Explained.
They are prepared to receive life; not to possess it.
That in the other life they are prepared, so that they can be kept in a state of persuasion. Explained.
They prepare their arrow upon the string ... ( = that they apply to doctrine falsities which appear like truths.)
Occurs. AE 594:12. AE 644:17.
To be prepared by God () = to be provided by the Lord; for that which is done by man is prepared; but that which is done by the Lord is provided.

All... after death are prepared either for Heaven or for Hell; all according to their life as in conformity with their doctrine. With most, the preparation is effected through instructions by Angels; but the Dutch... cannot be prepared through informations; they do not receive them... and therefore they are prepared in another way. Explained.
Thus are they prepared for Heaven, not by others, but by themselves...
Preparatory Judgments before the Last Judgment...
In the World of Spirits he changes his Societies, and is thus prepared either for Heaven or for Hell...
At last, when the man has been prepared, his love is the head of all other things...
Thus the lungs are the praeparatorium...
